FIFA World Cup matches conclude with notable upsets and controversies

Several FIFA World Cup matches have concluded, featuring Belgium's victory over the USA in a match marked by a red card reversal controversy. Other games saw Switzerland advance, Spain eliminate Portugal, and Norway defeat Brazil. Separately, a US player with Nigerian roots faced scrutiny over birthright citizenship, and a Belgian player sustained a knee injury.
